title: Truly worth seeing for the tiger puppet alone #Broadway #play #lifeof...
transcript: Life of Pi just announced that it is closing on Broadway and I just wanted to say if you have not seen the show yet go see the show you have one more month left to do so it is one of my favorite things I've ever seen My hot take is that it was my favorite play of this past season I really think it's one of those shows that everyone should see Technically it is so impressive The storytelling is next level The puppets I mean come on go see Life of Pi you have one more month left to do it it is so good
